rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on every northstar_privacy table, then drops rights_request, consent_record, data_field and the northstar_privacy schema (CASCADE). consent_record holds the immutable, auditable consent history and rights_request holds data-subject-rights evidence, so on a shared environment export the schema first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_privacy schema with data_field, consent_record and rights_request tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every northstar_privacy table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 6 privacy & legal readiness module (GATE-PRIVACY build core): a data catalog declaring purpose + lawful basis + retention per personal-data field, versioned immutable consent history, authenticated access/export/erase data-subject-rights workflows, deletion propagation across every registered store until deletion_residue == 0, and clock-controlled retention purging that honors stricter data classes
